```{r functions, eval = FALSE}

func_UTF8 <- 
  function(x) {
    if(is.character(x)) {
      iconv(x, from = "UTF-8", to = "UTF-8", sub = "byte")
    } 
    else { x }
  }

Q1 <- function(x, na.rm=TRUE){
  quantile(x, na.rm=na.rm)[2]  # first quartile
}

Q3 <- function(x, na.rm=TRUE){
  quantile(x, na.rm=na.rm)[4]  # third quartile
}

numSummary <- 
  function(x) {
    return( c(length(x), 
            n_distinct(x),
            sum(is.na(x) | x == "" | trimws(x) == ""), 
            mean(x, na.rm=TRUE), 
            min(x, na.rm=TRUE), 
            Q1(x, na.rm=TRUE), 
            median(x, na.rm=TRUE),
            Q3(x, na.rm=TRUE), 
            max(x, na.rm=TRUE), 
            sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)))
    }

catSummary <- 
  function(x) {
    return(c(length(x), 
           n_distinct(x), 
           sum(is.na(x) | x == "" | trimws(x) == ""),
           getmodes(x,type=1),  
           getmodesCnt(x,type=1),
           getmodes(x,type=2),  
           getmodesCnt(x,type=2),
           getmodes(x,type=-1), 
           getmodesCnt(x,type=-1)))
  }

getmodes <- 
  function(v,type=1) {
    tbl <- table(v)
    m1<-which.max(tbl)
    if (type==1) {
      return (names(m1)) #1st mode  
    }
    else if (type==2) {
      return (names(which.max(tbl[-m1]))) #2nd mode
    }
    else if (type==-1) {
      return (names(which.min(tbl))) #least common mode
    }
    else {
      stop("Invalid type selected")
    }
  }

getmodesCnt <- 
  function(v,type=1) {
    tbl <- table(v)
    m1<-which.max(tbl)
    if (type==1) {
      return (max(tbl)) #1st mode freq
    }
    else if (type==2) {
      return (max(tbl[-m1])) #2nd mode freq
    }
    else if (type==-1) {
      return (min(tbl)) #least common freq
    }
    else {
      stop("Invalid type selected")
    }
  }

get_mode <- function(v) {
  uniq_vals <- unique(v)
  uniq_vals[which.max(tabulate(match(v, uniq_vals)))]
}

```


```{r data_divided, eval = FALSE}

train_data_new[] <- lapply(train_data_new, func_UTF8)

numData_train <- train_data_new %>%
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric))

catData_train <- train_data_new %>%
  dplyr::transmute(across(where(is.character), as.factor)) 


```

```{r data_numericSummary, eval = FALSE}

# numericSummary_train: Generate a data quality report for the numeric variables in the training dataset

#  1: Create a summary of numeric variables in the training dataset using numSummary, 
# which provides metrics like count, distinct values, missing values, mean, quartiles, 
# max, and standard deviation.
numericSummary_train <- numData_train %>% dplyr::reframe(across(everything(), numSummary))

#  2: Assign row labels to the summary metrics for clear identification in the report.
numericSummary_train <- 
  cbind(stat=c("n","unique","missing","mean",
               "min","Q1","median","Q3","max","sd"), 
        numericSummary_train)

#  3: Transform the data into a more readable format, calculate missing and unique percentages,
# and reorder columns to prioritize essential metrics at the start of the report.
numericSummary_train <- numericSummary_train %>%
  pivot_longer(!stat, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(missing_pct = 100*missing/n,                                                   
                unique_pct = 100*unique/n) %>%
  dplyr::select(variable, n, missing, missing_pct, unique, unique_pct, everything())

#  4: Display the report in a readable table format and save it as an HTML file for reference.
options(digits=3)
options(scipen=99)
numericSummary_train %>% kable() %>% kable_styling(font_size = 12)

save_kable(
  numericSummary_train %>% kable() %>% kable_styling(font_size = 12),
  file = "numericSummary_train.html"
)



```


```{r categoricalSummary, eval = FALSE}

# categoricalSummary_train: Generate a data quality report for the categorical variables in the training dataset


#  2: Create a summary for categorical variables in the training dataset using catSummary,
# including metrics such as count, unique values, missing values, and modes (most common values).
categoricalSummary_train <- catData_train %>% dplyr::reframe(across(everything(), catSummary))

#  3: Generate row labels for the summary statistics, such as count, unique values, and frequency of modes.
categoricalSummary_train <- cbind(stat=c("n", "unique", "missing", "1st mode", "1st mode freq", "2nd mode", 
                                   "2nd mode freq", "least common", "least common freq"), categoricalSummary_train)

#  4: Transform the data into a more readable format, calculate additional metrics like missing 
# and unique percentages, and add a frequency ratio between the top two modes to assess mode dominance.
categoricalSummary_train <- categoricalSummary_train %>%
  pivot_longer(!stat, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(c(n, missing, unique, `1st mode freq`, `2nd mode freq`, 
                         `least common freq`), as.numeric))  %>%           
  dplyr::mutate(missing_pct = 100*missing/n,
                unique_pct = 100*unique/n,
                freqRatio = `1st mode freq`/ `2nd mode freq`) %>%
  dplyr::select(variable, n, missing, missing_pct, unique, unique_pct, freqRatio, everything())

#  5: Display the report in a readable table format and save it as an HTML file for reference.
options(digits=3)
options(scipen=99)
categoricalSummary_train %>% kable() %>% kable_styling(font_size = 12)

save_kable(
  categoricalSummary_train %>% kable() %>% kable_styling(font_size = 12),
  file = "categoricalSummary_train.html"
)


```

```{r}
# library(caret)

train_data_new$loan_status <- factor(train_data_new$loan_status, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))



customSummary2 <- function(data, lev = NULL, model = NULL) {
  # 确保 obs 是因子
  data$obs <- factor(data$obs, levels = lev)

  # 如果 pred 是数值型概率，则需要转换为分类结果
  if (is.numeric(data$pred)) {
    data$pred <- factor(ifelse(data$pred >= 0.5, lev[2], lev[1]), levels = lev)
  }

  # 计算 Accuracy
  acc <- mean(data$pred == data$obs)

  # 计算二分类指标
  sensitivity <- caret::sensitivity(data$pred, data$obs, positive = lev[2])
  specificity <- caret::specificity(data$pred, data$obs, negative = lev[1])

  # 计算 ROC（需要概率）
  roc <- twoClassSummary(data, lev, model)["ROC"]

  # 返回指标
  c(
    Accuracy = acc,
    ROC = roc,
    Sensitivity = sensitivity,
    Specificity = specificity
  )
}

# 设置训练控制参数
train_control <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",               # 使用交叉验证
  number = 10,                 # 10 折交叉验证
  summaryFunction = customSummary2,  # 使用自定义评估函数
  classProbs = TRUE,           # 输出分类概
  savePredictions = "final"
)



cl <- makeCluster(detectCores() - 1)  # 留一个核心给操作系统
registerDoParallel(cl)

gbm_model <- train(
  x = train_data_new[, -1],
  y = train_data_new$loan_status,
  method = "gbm", 
  trControl = train_control
)

stopCluster(cl)
registerDoSEQ()

# 查看交叉验证结果
gbm_model$results
print(gbm_model)
summary(gbm_model)



# 混淆矩阵
confusionMatrix(predict(gbm_model, train_data_new), train_data_new$loan_status)

# ROC 曲线
library(pROC)
roc_curve <- roc(train_data_new$loan_status, predict(gbm_model, train_data_new, type = "prob")[, "Yes"])
plot(roc_curve)


```
